notes.title: 2.6.0.0 - New Game and Content!
notes.content:
Greetings brain-trainers!

In this update we're happy to introduce:
[list]
[*][b] [NEW GAME] Shuffled[/b] - our latest mini-game designed to test and train your visual selective attention skills, which is the ability to focus on a relevant stimulus, while ignoring simultaneously presented stimuli that act as distractors.
[*][b] [NEW SEASON] Easter[/b] - during Easter season you will notice special environmental decorations and effects.
[/list]
We also improved the app's performance and resolved some minor bugs.

[i]* Please share your feedback, or direct any questions you might have, on our Discord server.[/i]

We wish you all a happy Easter season ahead!

notes.title: 2.3.0.0 - New Game & Content!
notes.content:
Greetings brain-trainers, in this update we're happy to introduce:
[list]
[*][b][[i]NEW GAME[/i]] Slinger[/b] - practice your speed and accuracy skills.
The goal is to hit an increasing number of targets before they disappear.
[*][b]Seasons [/b]- a new way to introduce seasonable content to your home scene.
Try logging in on your birthday for a surprise!
[*][b]Spanish language[/b] - all ENHANCE content is now localized in Spanish
[/list]
We also did performance optimization and resolved minor bugs

[i]* Please share your feedback, or direct any questions you might have, on our Discord server. 
[/i]
